🔺 Help the Warlock Count! How Many Triangles Are
There in the Picture?

The Warlock is busy counting the triangles...But this
picture might not be as simple as it looks? 👀
Come help him find out exactly how many triangles
are hidden in the picture!
📅 Event Period: August 23 – August 30
🎁 Rewards Sent: September 3

🔺How to Participate
Leave your answer in the comments, along with:
🔺The number of triangles you counted
🌍 Your Server Number
👤 Your in-game nickname

🎁 Rewards
10 eligible participants will be randomly selected to
receive a $4.99 Gold Block reward!

Think you’ve figured it out? 👀Come take on the
challenge and see who can count them fastest and
most accurately! 🔺✨
